scriptText:
I. THE HANDOVER

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a cinematic, melancholic drama scene set in a humid, late-night laundromat, featuring @actor1 as SAMIRA, an exhausted artist hiding deep depression, and @actor2 as FELIX, her gentle, reliable long-time friend.
[[/INTENT]]

[[LOGIC]]
Ensure strict spatial continuity on the bench, maintaining a clear 180-degree axis, consistent eye lines, and precise prop transfer tracking from Samira's coat pocket into Felix's hand.
[[/LOGIC]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
Medium: 35mm film, pronounced grain, shallow depth of field
Palette: Desaturated teal, harsh neon green reflections, dark slate blue
Lighting: Overhead flickering fluorescent tubes, soft rain-filtered street lighting
Location: Gritty 24-hour urban laundromat, row of spinning dryer drums, steamed glass storefront
Wardrobe Samira: Oversized navy woolen trench coat, dark ribbed beanie, charcoal sweater, worn leather boots
Wardrobe Felix: Dark maroon hooded sweatshirt, waxed canvas jacket, dark relaxed denim
Audio: Heavy rain against glass, low rhythmic dryer hum, coin tumbling diegetics, soft breathing
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[OPENING]]
[CAM 01] MCU, eye-level, fixed side profile. Samira sits frame-left on a blue plastic bench, head resting softly on Felix's shoulder frame-right, staring blankly at the spinning dryer drums under flickering fluorescent light.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] Samira stares blankly forward -> [ENV] Dryer drums spin continuously behind them.
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] Samira shifts her head slightly -> SAMIRA says (soft sigh) {It feels so quiet in here—} -> [ACT] Samira blinks slowly at the spinning laundry.
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] Samira adjusts her posture subtly -> SAMIRA says {—like time just stopped.} -> [ACT] Felix tilts his head gently toward her.
[CAM 02] CU, low-angle, focused on bench seating -> [ACT] Samira slides her right hand slowly into her coat pocket
[CAM 02] -> [ACT] Samira retrieves a brass key ring -> SAMIRA says {I won't be needing these—} -> [ACT] Samira holds the keys over Felix's open palm.
[CAM 02] -> [ACT] Samira presses the brass keys gently into his palm -> FELIX says (soft laugh) {For your new place?} -> [ACT] Felix closes his fingers securely over the keys.
[CAM 02] -> [ACT] Samira squeezes his closed fist firmly with both hands
[CAM 03] MCU, over-the-shoulder, looking past Felix to Samira -> [ACT] Samira closes her eyes tightly -> SAMIRA says (trembling exhale) {Yeah— a fresh start.} -> [ACT] Samira rests her cheek deeper against his shoulder.
[CAM 03] -> [ACT] Samira tightens her fingers around his jacket sleeve -> SAMIRA says {Thank you for staying tonight.} -> [ACT] Felix gazes warmly across the empty room.
[CAM 03] -> [ACT] Felix rests his chin gently atop her beanie
[CAM 01] MCU, eye-level, fixed side profile -> [ACT] Samira inhales a deep breath slowly -> SAMIRA says (muffled whisper) {Just stay like this—} -> [ACT] Samira remains completely still against his side.
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] Samira relaxes her shoulders completely -> SAMIRA says {—for one last minute.} -> [ACT] Felix pats her hand reassuringly.
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] Samira keeps her eyes closed peacefully -> [ENV] Rain streams down the exterior glass door.
[CAM 03] MCU, over-the-shoulder view -> [ACT] Samira swallows hard -> SAMIRA says (shaky breath) {Don't forget this.} -> [ACT] Samira rests silently against his chest.
[CAM 01] MCU, wide bench composition -> [ACT] Felix smiles calmly while Samira rests motionless on his shoulder -> FELIX says {Never, Sam.} -> [ACT] Both sit together as laundry tumbles endlessly in background.
[</BRIEF>]
